claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lamivudine is a cytosine nucleoside analogue that requires phosphorylation and incorporation into viral/HIV reverse transcriptase; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled human cancer cell line viability screen it is expected to be largely inactive because it lacks a cytotoxic off-target or physicochemical killing mechanism at this concentration.
